description: EXPERIMENTAL ONLY: Oriel per-user setup managed through Scoop scripts and a junction to its external install location.

script: $setup = Join-Path -Path $dir -ChildPath 'OrielSetup-1.1.1.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $setup -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Oriel setup executable was not found in the Scoop version directory.' }
$process = Start-Process -FilePath $setup -ArgumentList @('--silent') -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
if (-not $process.WaitForExit(45000)) { Stop-Process -Id $process.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; throw 'Oriel setup timed out after 45 seconds.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Oriel setup exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }
$installDir = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Oriel'
$appExe = Join-Path $installDir 'oriel.exe'
$uninstaller = Join-Path $installDir 'uninstall.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $appExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Oriel executable was not found at $appExe." }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Oriel uninstaller was not found at $uninstaller." }
$linkPath = Join-Path $dir 'oriel-managed'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $linkPath) { throw "Refusing to overwrite existing managed link: $linkPath" }
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $linkPath -Target $installDir | Out-Null
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $linkPath 'oriel.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The managed Oriel junction does not resolve to oriel.exe.' }
$installDir = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Oriel'
$uninstaller = Join-Path $installDir 'uninstall.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Registered Oriel uninstaller not found: $uninstaller" }
$process = Start-Process -FilePath $uninstaller -ArgumentList @('--uninstall') -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
if (-not $process.WaitForExit(45000)) { Stop-Process -Id $process.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; throw 'Oriel uninstaller timed out after 45 seconds.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Oriel uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $installDir) { throw "Oriel install folder remains after uninstall: $installDir" }

notes: EXPERIMENTAL ONLY. Oriel installs into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Oriel instead of the Scoop version folder. The post_install script creates a junction for Scoop shims; the uninstaller uses the command recorded in the Oriel Windows uninstall registry entry. This is a non-portable experiment and may conflict with Oriel's built-in self-updater.
